podcasts.title: BB3 - Slots & Daggers (slot machine rogue-like)
podcasts.text: Slots & Daggers is a slot machine rogue-like where players choose their slot symbols, spin the wheel, and attempt to defeat increasingly powerful enemies. It mixes some of the best elements of other slot rogue-likes like Clover Pit with the tried-and-true combat of Slay the Spire. Its first four hours is well worth playing, but what value does it provide to us beyond that? Listen in to find out.
